quarterly_data.quarter: Lambda press release: What Lambda is building with NVIDIA at GTC Berlin 2026 (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Lambda announced support for Confidential Bare Metal, the expansion of NVIDIA Confidential Computing to dedicated third-party infrastructure (hardware-rooted isolation and attestation for frontier model builders on bare-metal instances), alongside Confidential Containers and Confidential Virtual Machines; in September it joined NVIDIA to support open agent safety.
